about.headline: Mobile Developer (Flutter / React Native)
about.content: Detail-oriented Mobile Developer with 2+ years of experience specializing in cross-platform development using Flutter and React Native. Proven track record in implementing complex business logic, integrating real-time features (WebSockets), and optimizing app performance. Strong advocate for Clean Architecture and maintainable code, with hands-on experience in the full mobile app lifecycle from development to store deployment.
highlights: Cross-platform mobile development with Flutter and React Native.
Real-time features integration: WebSocket, messaging, and streaming stability improvements.
Architecture-focused: Clean Architecture, MVVM, Repository Pattern.
End-to-end delivery: development, debugging production issues, and store deployments.

experience.summary: Developed core UI components and business features for a high-traffic social Q&A platform.
highlights: Implemented infinite scroll and pagination logic to handle large datasets efficiently.
Integrated WebSockets for real-time messaging and REST APIs for data persistence.
Optimized app performance by reducing unnecessary widget rebuilds and refining BLoC state transitions.
Tech Stack: Flutter, BLoC, REST API, WebSocket.

experience.summary: Architected job listing and search filter features with advanced form validation.
highlights: Streamlined backend integration with robust error handling and pagination.
Managed the deployment process for both Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
Resolved critical production bugs, improving user retention and app stability.
Tech Stack: Flutter, Provider, REST API.

experience.summary: Maintained and scaled existing React Native applications for IoT device management.
highlights: Improved video/data streaming stability and significantly reduced latency for real-time monitoring.
Refactored legacy codebases to improve readability and developer onboarding speed.
Tech Stack: React Native, JavaScript, Redux.

experience.summary: Automated data migration tasks using AWS Lambda and Java scripts.
highlights: Collaborated with the backend team to monitor system health during cloud transition.
